0.0: You came to such a dangerous place... Amazing! We're here to work, but there are so many monsters in our way. I don't want to see you hurt, but we do need the help. Just be careful.
0.1: Hmm, but then again, if you're here in the first place, then you're strong enough. We've been looking for someone that can help us in our journey, and it's you! You might be busy taking care of other things, too, but please set aside some time for us. Please...?

yes.0: Thanks! As you may know, this place is pretty abandoned, but a lot of the workers are here on special duties. I can move around with the old-school spring being rewound, but most of the new workers are operated in batteries.
yes.1: But we've also been lacking batteries to the point where some workers cannot even perform expected duties because of the lack of power. The worst thing that can happen is for each and every one of us to freeze altogether. I don't even want to think of the possibilities.
yes.2: You know what a #b#t4000111#s#k looks like, right? Well, I need about 100 of them to get the workers running again. The #r#erobotic monsters#k#n in the toy factory have them. Bring them to me before all the power runs out.

no.0: Sigh... this is precisely the time when we need your help. Who are we going to ask for?

1.0: You've returned at last! Let's see... This is the right kind of #b#t4000111#s#k, and you got 100 of them. Excellent! With these, I can power up the workers before they wind down for good. Here, take this for helping us out. You deserve it.

yes.0: Alright, the batteries are going to be in now. Thanks for your hard work. Thank you. Thank you. Hopefully you'll make it to the bottom safely!

item.0: Please hurry before all the workers shut down. You can find at least one #b#t4000111##k on the robotic monsters in the toy factory. I need 100 of those, please.

QuestInfo.name: The Clock Workers' Batteries
QuestInfo.0: I should check on #p2040029#, who is working hard at the Lost Time.
QuestInfo.1: You met Grandpa Clock again deep in the halls of Lost Time of Ludibrium. Grandpa Clock says he can work on a clock spring, but modern clocks all work on batteries, and many of the Clocktower's clocks have run out of power. #b100 cheap batteries#k should get everything moving again.
QuestInfo.2: I got the cheap batteries needed for the new battery-operated worker clocks. #p2040029# seemed ecstatic over the prospect of those workers finally showing life and lessening his work burden in the process. Anyway, what exactly are they doing in there...?
